notes.title: 《Endless Journey'》has been officially released!!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

After eight months of polishing and iteration, and dozens of major and minor updates, today the official version of 'Endless Journey' is finally released! And in the first week of its launch, a new historical low discount will be launched!

On behalf of all members of 'Endless Journey', I would like to say to all players: Thank you! Thank you! Thank you for your support, valuable suggestions, and the hard work of the testing players, all of which have given us unlimited motivation.
Although 'Endless Journey' has been officially released, it is only a new starting point for the game's content to become more complete, and it does not represent the end of this game. We will update it irregularly for a long time to continue optimizing the gaming experience. Please rest assured!

This update mainly includes:
[list]
[*] Two new DLC characters have been added, each with unique and powerful mechanisms, as well as their corresponding equipment and treasures.
[*] Added the talent skill function for characters, which will bring more playability to character construction.
[*] Two new elixirs have been added, which can be used to reset character levels and restore character talents.
[*] Added the function of reincarnation and re cultivation for characters in the second playthrough. Characters at full level will be able to retain some cultivation attributes and restart cultivation.
[*] Supplement the skills of the Spirit Beast Boss (can also appear when using the corresponding medium for equipment forging).
[*] Weakens the values of various percentage skills, and only retains the percentage effect of lost health in the game.
[*] Significantly reduced the time required for refining some medicinal pills.
[*] and other optimizations and problem fixes of various sizes
[/list]
Thank you again for your support and love for the Endless Journey~(´▽`ʃ♡ƪ)

notes.title: V0.3.1 Update log
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone!
The Spring Festival is approaching, and I would like to extend my greetings to all of you in advance. Wishing you a happy Lunar New Year! [/h3]
It has been six months since the EA version was launched. During the past six months, we have maintained a regular weekly update frequency and released over 40 game updates of various sizes; Based on the opinions and suggestions of a large number of players, the game content has been comprehensively expanded and optimized.
This is our promise when launched, and we will strive to fulfill it and not disappoint the expectations.(๑•̀ㅂ•́)و
In the new year, we will continue to make various supplements and optimizations to the game, improve operational convenience, and bring players more and more fun game content~

Speaking back to now, the following is the updated game content:
[h3] [New Content] [/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the storyline and task flow for the second week of the game. Once the main storyline of the fairy world is completed, the game can begin.
[*] Added drop and forging functions for magical equipment (second week content).
[*] Added the synthesis function of the alchemy room, which can be activated after level 4 of the alchemy room to synthesize low-level materials into high-level materials.
[*] Added some formulas for synthesis.
[*] Added or replaced some art resources.
[/list]
[h3] [Optimization and Adjustment] [/h3]
[list]
[*] Significantly reduced the value of mana replenishment during enemy ghost evasion.
[*] The automatically claimed sect resources will no longer frequently pop up bubble prompts.
[*] Zongmen Architecture - The house will now automatically record the previous sorting information.
[/list]
[h3] [Problem fix] [/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where some plot dialogues sometimes froze and could only be skipped.
[*] Fixed the issue where the task reward for the side quest "catching medicine" was not correctly obtained.
[*] Fixed the issue of incorrect output in the resource building prompts for clicking on "Mine" and "Quarry".
[*] Fixed the issue of logical errors in bulk sales of Zongmen Architecture - Houses.
[*] Fixed the issue where the equipment skill "X Spirit Blessing · Si" displayed a level higher than the actual value.
[*] Fixed the issue of errors in the "Spirit Mine" materials produced by the special area Boss in each chapter.
[*] Fixed some text description errors.
[/list]

At the same time, our previous work 'Idle Devils' will also be updated later. Interested players can pay more attention to it~
Thank you all for your support and love all along. See you next year~(´▽`ʃ♡ƪ)

[h3] Finally, we apologize once again for the bad gaming experience we have brought to all players. [/h3]

notes.title: Game Development Log (Issue 1)
notes.content:
Although "Endless Immortal Journey" has not been officially released yet, we already have dozens of members in our player community (QQ Group ID: 537185437).

We value the opinions and suggestions of our players and hope to communicate better with everyone. Therefore, we have decided to maintain weekly updates of the "Game Development Log" until the official release.

As this is the first entry, this log will provide a general overview of the game's basic framework and update plans. In subsequent updates, we will provide more detailed reports based on the weekly work.

The basic framework of "Endless Immortal Journey" consists of three main systems:

1. Sect System:
Mainly featuring simulated management gameplay, the sect will generate resources over game time, used for constructing the sect and exchanging various items.
Buildings in the sect system are categorized as core buildings, functional buildings, and resource buildings.
Functions such as forging equipment, refining elixirs, and recruiting disciples are included in functional buildings, which are closely related to the character cultivation system.

2. Character Cultivation System:
A system where players enhance the strength of their teams through various means.
Main dimensions of character cultivation include advancing realms, equipping gear, combining and upgrading skills, choosing paths, and practicing martial arts.
By combining equipment, paths, and martial arts, even characters of the same profession may have vastly different final forms.
Powerful effects of 1+1>2 can be achieved by further combining skills among different characters.

3. Combat System:
While exploring the continent, players will engage in numerous battles with various enemies.
Defeating these enemies yields rich spoils used to directly enhance character realms or to manufacture items in sect buildings.
As players travel across the continent, they will also collect increasing reputation, one of the necessary conditions for upgrading the sect.
Time-limited special events and battles will be triggered at specific points during the in-game year, month, or special occasions.
We plan to release a trial version in February of next year (before the Spring Festival), which will include the following content:

Guidance, tasks, levels, and plot flow content for the first two chapters of the game.
1.Maximum realm for player characters extended to Foundation Establishment realm.
2.Core sect buildings and resource buildings all unlocked, with external functions available: recruiting 3.disciples, and equipment forging.
4.Disciple recruitment feature: In addition to the main character, at least 8 collectible characters.
5.Equipment forging feature: At least 70 types of craftable regular equipment and some unique equipment with rare drops.
6.Main character can freely combine skills from other professions.
